items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I know Tuxedas, that was Papa Celestans. And Ada Jackson. The trubor player. Yeah, the sousaphone player. And I just can't think of who I was in the band at the time, but I remember the band when I was quite a young fellow.

ctx.x: I remember. Same type of thing. I wondered if any bands ever played out in that park, you know, where they had a bandstand, like if that was for brass band concerts I heard they used to give there. Do you remember anything like that?

No, I don't remember nothing like that. But I remember several brass bands that they had around the city of New Orleans when I was quite a youngster coming up. They had Excelsa brass band and they had Tuxedas brass band. That was time of Papa Celestans. And had the Imperial brass band. Another brass band that I knew, Silverleaf. All that was around Bunk Johnson them times.
Do you remember who were in some of those bands, like the Excelsior, who the leader was?
